entities.summary: Chatuphum Chinnawong is a Thai weightlifter competing in the 77 kg category. He finished fourth at the 2012 Summer Olympics and 2016 Summer Olympics. This stands to be upgraded to third, pending the IOC medal reallocation process, as a result of the gold medalist being disqualified for doping offences.
